Home

Everyday Sparks 2.0

Micro-Credential

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This microcredential recognizes your engagement with the Everyday Sparks 2.0 module and your thoughtful reflection on how everyday moments can inspire meaningful writing. By exploring Daily Schedules, Take a Line for a Walk and Interpreting Visual Texts, you’ve taken the next step to cultivating literacy routines that empower students to see the writing potential in their daily lives.

Criteria

To earn the microcredential for this module, be sure your reflection includes:

  • The strategy from this module you see as most immediately usable in your teaching context and why.

  • A brief description of other approaches you’ve used to sustain routine writing this year and any challenges you’ve encountered.
